prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from tray and move it to capping device to screw on the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: capping device
What the inspection checks: Check near capping device whether the test tube on the gripper has been screwed on.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: An enclosed automation workcell photographed from above. The frame is built from extruded aluminium profiles with white panels; a light grey worktable fills the lower left, scattered with small white specks and screws.

Centre right, a white robot arm (grey-trimmed, jointed) extends from the bottom edge toward a green circuit board mounted vertically on a black bracket, with a white rectangular label or chip at its centre and a black cable leading off to the right.

Behind the board sits a small orange-capped cylindrical vessel, closed, upright, its contents not visible. Above, a grey machine head with a yellow label and black column is mounted. A blue-tipped plug and cable rest at right.
observations: The inspection confirms that the orange-capped cylindrical vessel is present, closed, and upright near the capping device, indicating the cap has been successfully screwed on.
